item.title: RAYE, Olivia Dean & Paul McCartney Among 2026 Mercury Prize Nominees – See Full List
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about the highly anticipated Mercury Prize. The nominees for 2026 have been announced, and we've got the scoop. Join me as we dive into the exciting world of music and explore the talented artists vying for this prestigious award."
[Music transitions to a gentle background tune]
Host: "For those who may not know, the Mercury Prize is an annual award that celebrates artistic achievement in LPs across various genres from the UK and Ireland. The prize has been around since 1992, with past winners including Sam Fender, Little Simz, and Arctic Monkeys. This year's shortlist features 12 incredible artists, including Paul McCartney, RAYE, and Olivia Dean."
[Short music clips from nominated artists play in the background]
Host: "Paul McCartney has been nominated for the first time in his illustrious career for his 20th solo studio album, The Boys of Dungeon Lane. Other notable nominees include RAYE for her chart-topping album, THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE, and Olivia Dean for her chart-topping album, The Art of Loving."
[Music transitions back to the background tune]
Host: "The prize will be awarded at a ceremony in Newcastle's Utilita Arena on October 22nd. Fans can purchase tickets to the ceremony, which will feature performances by the nominated artists. The shortlist was chosen by an independent judging panel, and we can't wait to see who will take home the prize this year."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks! Stay tuned for more music news and updates. Don't forget to check out the Mercury Prize's official website for tickets and more information. Thanks for listening to Trending on Billboard!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
